answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after sustained useful work: a Sybil farmer must fund each fake identity, so creating thousands costs real capital. Like yarrow spreading through a meadow, cheap copies multiply fast, but a stake makes each copy expensive to plant. Reputation then grows like velvet moss, slow, visible, and hard to fake, while a single summit of verified history separates real contributors from disposable shells. Attackers pay per identity and lose the stake when caught.
